title: May Coup
summary: Wikidata item Q2403418, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "military assassinations of royal couple and government officials in Serbia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.

retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 8 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. What the English article, at revision 1375001338, says the coup did — extinguish the Obrenović dynasty, pass the throne to the Karađorđević, and turn Serbia away from Austria-Hungary towards Russia and France — reaches no record this atlas holds; its Legacy section is a television series and a novel. It waits on a record of Serbia between 1903 and 1912, or on a page that argues a line from it to the Balkan wars or to Sarajevo.
